question: Does the exact early buyer churn feature replicate prospectively on a fresh acquisition and retain incremental negative association with Fixed+60 outcomes beyond Participant Quality and existing flow evidence?

feature_contract.definition: Within the causal T0..T0+5s Pump trade sequence, maintain observed acquired token inventory per wallet. Buys add token_amount_raw. A sell matches only up to that wallet's currently observed acquired inventory; unmatched sell quantity is ignored. Sum matched sellback across wallets and divide by total observed buy token_amount_raw.
feature_contract.oversell_policy: matched only up to currently observed acquired inventory
feature_contract.event_causality: first_received_wall_ns must be within episode T0..T0+5s and decoded chain timestamp must be within observed_t0..observed_t0+5

instrumentation.snapshot_stage: feature snapshot must be enriched after T0+5 causal coverage is complete and before any provider quote/outcome call starts

fresh_confirmation.insufficient_rule: If fewer than 30 primary route-closed feature/outcome pairs, return INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE_NO_EXTENSION and do not extend or repeat based on observed outcomes.
fresh_confirmation.negative_confirmation_rule: If sample is sufficient but the preregistered keep rule fails, return NO_CONFIRMATION_CLOSE_OR_REVIEW without threshold search or feature redefinition.
